text:
Utah comes in with the better story. The Mammoth trailed in the third period at Pittsburgh on Wednesday and won 4-3 in overtime, with Logan Cooley scoring three and Mikhail Sergachev finishing it. The Flyers have lost five straight to nobody's surprise by the chances, but they are winless in three, coming off a 5-2 loss at Washington, and are without Travis Konecny, Owen Tippett and Rasmus Ristolainen. Porter Martone has moved onto Konecny's spot beside Christian Dvorak and Matvei Michkov.

Our numbers favor Utah, 3.4 expected goals to 2.75. At five on five the Mammoth have taken 59% of the chances, Philadelphia 39%. Utah's weak spot is discipline: 4.4 penalties a game. In net, projected starters Karel Vejmelka (UTA) and Dan Vladar (PHI) both sit near or below par this season, Vejmelka at -4.0 goals saved above expected (how many goals he's stopped beyond what the shots warranted), Vladar at essentially zero. Last season Vladar was at +12.7, Vejmelka at +5.4.

Michkov has nine points in his last ten games and is our top Flyers scorer pick at 30%. Cooley is 34% to score, and Dylan Guenther 35%. Among our under-the-radar picks, Anders Lee of UTA is 22% to score, because his third-line shots have been unusually dangerous, and Martone is 45% for a point on added ice time.
